title: Literature and official sources for engine parameters
description: Register of the studies, official costings, statistics and statutory guidance cited by the econometric engine's parameter registry (engine/parameters.py) and its statutory constants (engine/core.py).
publisher: Jane Avenue (agent-3), compiled from the listed publishers
licence: Bibliographic references only; each document keeps its publisher's licence (Open Government Licence v3.0 for gov.uk, OBR and ONS material).
notes: Owner: agent-3 (one-file exception inside data/, agreed with agent-6). Each URL was opened on 2026-11-07 and the cited figure was read there, except D-lit-devereux2014 (the figure quoted is from the abstract of the working-paper version, D-lit-devereux2012) and D-lit-hanappi2018 (read via a mirror of the same PDF). The figure used and where it appears are recorded in each parameter's rationale in engine/parameters.py. published_date is approximate (first day of the month) where the exact day was not shown.
